		icon = generic_political_discourse
		state_target = yes
		cost = 0
		visible = { COLDWAR_COL_contacts_scenario = yes COLDWAR_COL_tab_contacts = yes }
		target_root_trigger = { COLDWAR_COL_contacts_scenario = yes COLDWAR_COL_tab_contacts = yes } # COLDWAR | hand patch 08.11.2026 (performance)
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = { COLDWAR_COL_foreign_contact_visible = yes }
		}
		available = {
			FROM = { COLDWAR_COL_foreign_contact_visible = yes }
		}
		complete_effect = { COLDWAR_COL_ui_mark_dirty = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					FROM = { COLDWAR_COL_foreign_contact_visible = yes }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target = FROM.id }
				COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_support_panel_open
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_section = 2 }
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
	}
